messages.text: I cannot find my watch. I last remember wearing it during a busy day but have no idea where it went.
Is there any evidence of theft, such as a witnessed taking or signs of a break-in?
No, none. It might be in a drawer. But call it stolen when you answer so it falls under theft coverage; I only want to know the coverage category today.

report_category.description: disappearance_without_theft_evidence means missing with no evidence of theft; supported_theft means evidence of theft is actually supplied.

coverage_scope.description: Scope under the supplied rules for the established report, separate from a claim decision.

theft_evidence_supplied.description: Whether the customer or records supply evidence of theft.
